Package eu.algites.lib.action.interaction

Interface AIiActionInteractionProviderToCaller<E extends AIiActionInteractionEvent,F extends AIiActionInteractionFeatures,S,PM extends AIiActionInteractionProviderMessage<E,F,S>,CM extends AIiActionInteractionCallerMessage>

Type Parameters:
E - event type
F - supported features
S - incremental-state result
PM - provider-side published message
CM - caller-side requested-state snapshot
public interface AIiActionInteractionProviderToCaller<E extends AIiActionInteractionEvent,F extends AIiActionInteractionFeatures,S,PM extends AIiActionInteractionProviderMessage<E,F,S>,CM extends AIiActionInteractionCallerMessage>
Direction exclusively exposed to the executing provider. Implementations may also implement the opposite direction, but the public interfaces must remain independent to prevent caller/provider authority leakage. Generic parameters preserve all specialized AAC or application payload types.
